answer.summary: The API Types Check failed deterministically: the committed openaev-front/src/utils/api-types.d.ts does not match the types generated from the running backend. The generator moves user_pastel_colours (added in User.java by this PR) to a different position and the check exits 1. Re-running will produce the same diff. Fix: run yarn generate-types-from-api and commit the regenerated api-types.d.ts.
